stem:
Read this sentence from paragraph 30.

"Every ding, dent, and scratch can tell a tale," he said.

What is the most likely reason the author includes this imagery?

options.label: A
options.text: To show that Grandpa likes to read stories about trumpets

options.label: B
options.text: To show that Grandpa thinks Kevin needs a new trumpet

options.label: C
options.text: To show that Grandpa thinks playing the trumpet matters more than how it looks

options.label: D
options.text: To show that Grandpa wants Kevin to explain each mark on the trumpet to his friends
